title: memory allocations in every step of userRigidBodyTest with symbolic user functions
author: Claude-JG
description: Maintainer 2026-10-19: userRigidBodyTest.py with 10000 steps reports 613350 memory allocations for the body with symbolic user functions (ODE2RHS 83 %, user functions 91 %); find the cause, improve if possible, or plan the step.
releaseNotes: ObjectUserBody allocates no memory in a time step: Matrix.CopyFrom keeps the memory for the same size, the result cache of the body copies into its entries, and the body keeps its buffers (revision2026c step RG12.2.3)
